text.en:
In due recognition of the outstanding services of the late Dr. Jose N. Rodriguez in the
improvement of the lot of leprosy patients and as a fitting memorial to all the good things which he
accomplished during his lifetime for the welfare and benefit of the said patients, the Central Luzon Sanitarium
at Tala, City of Caloocan, of which he was the first Director, is hereby renamed Dr. Jose N. Rodriguez
Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: December 24, 1980
